proposed_fixes.title: Capture F11 only when the keyboard sends it to Keyboard Manager
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Lenovo Vantage or the laptop's Fn/hotkey firmware may intercept the physical F11 event, so the remap editor receives no ordinary F11 key event to record.
plan: Reproduce on v0.102.3001 with the exact Lenovo model and Fn/hotkey mode, checking whether F11 launches Vantage outside the remap editor.

confidence.rationale: The observed Lenovo Vantage launch suggests an OEM hotkey conflict, but the laptop model, Fn mode, and current-build behavior are missing; no PowerToys defect is established.

comment.body:
Thanks for including the screenshot and report archive. The issue says F11 launches Lenovo Vantage while you are selecting a remap, but it does not identify the laptop model or Fn/hotkey mode. Could you please:
1. Retest on the latest stable v0.102.3001 and share the Lenovo model and Fn/hotkey mode.
2. Check whether pressing F11 outside the remap dialog also launches Lenovo Vantage, and whether F11 is captured if it does not.
3. If the current capture failure remains when Vantage does not consume the key, comment `/bugreport` immediately after reproducing.
This will distinguish an OEM hotkey interception from a Keyboard Manager capture failure.
